{{Quote|This is Imperial Automated Defense Corps unit CR-97. By order of Darth Zhorrid, Lord of the Dark Council, your ship is now in lockdown.|CR-97|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''CR-97''' was a personal [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zhorrid]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] it contacted an [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] through a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], after which his master sent the agent to find [[Vyord Yanol]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
